Human progress is powered by smart machines - smart machines are powered by human visions

As machines are becoming smarter - performance, safety and reliability have never been more important. We provide these attributes for millions of mobile machines worldwide, right here in the heart of Europe. If you come work with TTControl in Vienna, your visions will be on board, too. 1 Project Manager (m/f/d) - HMI Product Development 

Take the lead in shaping innovative development projects in the off-highway sector. As a Project Manager, you own projects from concept to delivery, ensuring scope, schedules, budgets, and quality targets are achieved.

Working at the intersection of customers, engineering teams, and international partners, you turn complex technical requirements into clear project strategies and tangible results. Supported by experienced experts, you coordinate cross-functional collaboration, manage challenges proactively, and contribute to the successful realization of cutting-edge solutions.

Your Tasks

 * Manage project scope, schedule, and cost within development projects

 * Drive comprehensive and professional project planning, setup, tracking, and steering

 * Develop work breakdown structures, effort estimations, and resource plans in cooperation with technical leads

 * Coordinate cross-functional teams and collaborate with international partners and suppliers

 * Translate technical challenges into structured execution plans and decisions

 * Monitor progress, identify and manage risks proactively, and ensure transparent reporting to stakeholders

Your Profile

 * Degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field (TU/FH or equivalent)

 * Experience in project coordination or project management within development projects (off-highway, automotive, embedded systems, or similar industries)

 * Solid project management knowledge (planning, risk, and stakeholder management)

 * PMP, PMI, IPMA, PRINCE2, or similar certification is a plus

 * Experience with MS Project, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools

 * Technical understanding of software and electronics development

 * Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills

 * Very good communication skills in English

Our Offer

 * Exciting work environment - be part of future high-tech innovations and cutting-edge technologies

 * We are a team - flat hierarchies, open door policy, communication at eye level and hands-on mentality

 * Central locations - our offices are located in the city center near Karlsplatz & Kettenbrückengasse, easily accessible via public transport and bicycle

 * Benefits Package - lunch tickets, job tickets (unlimited use of public transport in Vienna or partially reimbursement of costs for KlimaTicket, numerous discounts, events and much more

 * Work-life-balance - additional days off, home office, workcation (up to 45 workdays per year Mobile Working within the EU) and individual working time models

 * Development & training - Individual onboarding program, TTTECH Academy and internal career opportunities

As of today, TTTECH Group employs more than 1,100 people in 11 locations worldwide. Join our pioneering team and become part of our fascinating projects. You will find it #mindgrowing

We provide an attractive and performance-based salary, which is based on your qualifications and professional experience. This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for Employees in the Metal Trade ("Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte Metallgewerbe") and we offer a minimum salary of € 57,000 gross per year. Actual compensation can be well above this standard.

Apply now!
